nexus.title: AI Engineer — Nexus, AI assistant for Unit4 ERP7
description: Co-built Nexus from first commit to production: designed the original LangGraph ReAct agent and the cross-company copy/compare workflow, with human confirmation before ERP writes
Built the streaming chat experience (live tool indicators, instant tables) and persistent conversations with a Postgres checkpointer; cut token usage by trimming tool outputs
Hardened the platform with JWT authentication, per-user rate limiting and Redis-backed caching
Built LLM cost control (usage metering, per-user and per-org spend caps, admin dashboards); set up daily backups and automated releases
